_about: Layout rules of the video-only screens, in 1920x1080 design px. The one source of positions, sizes and times: py promo/layout_build.py writes layout.data.js from this file, layout.js turns it into CSS variables and coordinates, bgm.py reads the times. Units: x, y, w, h are design px (top-left origin); other lengths end in _px, times (from the start of the cut) end in _s. Keys starting with _ are notes. Values were read from the pages as they were on 2026-11-03.

subtitle_band._note: the bottom 170 px hold nothing but the subtitles

safe._note: side margin 96, top margin 60, down to the subtitle band

_min_text_note: smallest font size at 1080p, Japanese and Latin alike. A rule of this project, not taken from an outside standard.

colors._note: night: ground of the title screens; ink: black ink on paper; tile_*: the N05 test tiles

n00._duration_note: 6.5 s is N00's slot in the narration script (draft 5: 0:00-0:06.5, the silent tail after the voice cut by 0.5 s)

times._note: name: first letter; row: agents and chips come in, unlit; light: first chip lights; step: gap between chips

n01._note: drawn by the screens department (web cut.html?cut=n01). 4.0 s is N01's slot in the narration script (0:07-0:11)

view._note: the 3D view; bottom 886, above the subtitle band

times._note: lead: still before the motion starts; zoom: the camera has come in

zoom._note: margin factor around the vehicle, from -> to

overlay._note: the condition past the limit, translucent red

n02._note: drawn by the screens department (web cut.html?cut=n02). 7.0 s is N02's slot in the narration script (0:11-0:18)

grid._note: five tests and the legend; bottom 886, above the subtitle band

result._note: limit values on the right; rows: result lines per test

overlay._note: the condition past the limit, translucent red

grid._note: cell (c, r) at x + c * (tile_w + gap_x), y + r * (tile_h + gap_y); spans safe.x to 1920 - safe.x

rate._note: not drawn on the promo screens

hero._note: centred; h follows the drawing (viewBox 600 x 300). src: picture of the vehicle alone on a transparent ground (a PNG, path relative to the page), fitted into the box (contain); empty: the line drawing of vehicle.js. ?hero=<path> in the page's URL wins over src

hero_motion._note: the vehicle grows to push_scale until times.burst_s, then to burst_scale and fades out over burst_dur_s (ease: cubic-bezier). The app's render (web/js/cut.js) uses all of these; promo n05.html uses push_scale only (the vehicle grows to it until the door swings wide, then fades out by door.hero_fade_*); burst_scale, burst_dur_s and ease are not used there

times._note: burst: flash of light as the door has swung out; tiles: first tile starts to fly in; tile_in: flight of one tile; tile_stagger: between tiles, nearest to fly_from first; door_open: the closed door starts to part (door.crack_*). burst, tiles, name and tag were 0.3 s earlier until 2026-11-03; they moved to leave the door closed a while first

door._note: double door over the whole stage behind the vehicle, two leaves of 960 x 1080 hinged on the outer edges, opening towards the viewer (kannon-biraki; rotateY, perspective_px from the stage's centre). Closed until times.door_open_s while the light in the seam grows; then the leaves part by crack_deg over crack_dur_s (crack_ease), stay there for hold_dur_s, and swing on to angle_deg over open_dur_s (ease: slow at first, then fast as the leaves pass out of the frame, near 68 deg). Fully open (and hidden) at door_open_s + crack_dur_s + hold_dur_s + open_dur_s = times.burst_s. The vehicle in front does not open: from the start of the wide swing it grows from hero_motion.push_scale to hero_fade_scale and fades out over hero_fade_dur_s. seam_w_px / seam_glow_w_px: the warm light in the seam and its halo; spill_dur_s: the light behind the door, seen through the opening, and the light that spills towards the viewer, both fade out over it from the start of the wide swing. panel: the two raised panels on each leaf (inset from the leaf's edges, upper panel height, gap between the panels, outline width, width of the raised border); handle: the pull next to the seam

fig._note: two figures, centred on the screen's middle with gap between them

bars._note: both bars share one scale: px_per_pct design px per percent. Was 8 until 2026-11-03; at 8 the 67.9 % bar (543 px) pushed its value 28 px past the bar area, at 7 (475 px) it has 40 px to spare

times._note: left: first figure, with the first sentence; right: second figure, just before the second sentence (voice at 5.0 s)
line: thin vertical line grows; open: it opens into a band; draw: vehicle strokes start; out: fade to black

band_exempt.why: authoring clock, drawn in the band with ?guides=1
N05's closed door covers the whole stage as the ground behind the vehicle until it opens (by n05.times.burst_s); it holds no text, and the subtitles are drawn over it

allow_overflow.why: line-height (1 to 1.3) is shorter than the font's content box (ascent + descent), so scrollHeight runs a few px past the line box. Measured 2-7 px (0.06-0.23 em). The glyphs stay inside and no ancestor clips them; a taller line-height would move the text

allow_escape.why: the caption fades up from 14 px below its place (0.6 s), so while it moves it reaches up to 14 px under the figure's box; at rest it is inside

allow_overlap.why: the vehicle is drawn over the vertical light on purpose
the vehicle stands in front of the closed door on purpose; it fades out as the door swings open
